answers.core: As above, it requires very significant effort to write a ShaderMaterial and to keep that material in line with existing BasicMaterial seems to be very difficult / impossible, and the hypothetical add-on written would not be compatible with any minor changes in the engine going forward. The change as presented (in-core) is much more portable and should survive major refactors.
answers.workaround: This can be implemented in godot via gdscript / shader. That would require the complete implementation of BasicMaterial in glsl and is not easy to carry on through version changes etc.
